Research & fidelity notes ＋

Recreated against contemporary iPhone 5 documentation and real iOS 6 screenshots. The display is rendered at the native 320 × 568-point layout, exactly 640 × 1136 Retina pixels, with five home-screen rows.

Icons are original iOS 6 assets archived from Apple devices. The rippled-water wallpaper is decoded from an iPhone 5 firmware still (Apple’s CgBI PNG flavor), alongside five additional firmware wallpapers. Everything is embedded for reliable offline rendering.

iPhone 5 / iOS 6 reference screenshots ↗Original iOS wallpaper archive ↗iOS 6 icon collection ↗

This is an independent tribute, not affiliated with Apple. Calls and SMS are simulations. Camera, microphone, maps and weather use browser permissions and public services where noted inside each app.
